analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold at 42.1 and consolidated above neutral at 50.7. MACD histogram improved from -6.1801 to -2.2564. Confirmed Higher Low pattern with 5-day low ($410.22) above 20-day low ($407.13). Three consecutive days of gains (+2.95%, +1.40%, +1.49%) maintain upward momentum. Weekly RSI entered bullish territory at 56.3. ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 21.1, but daily indicators strengthen the buy signal.
